notes: BLOCKED: ata.gov.al (Albanian Telegraphic Agency) puts a Cloudflare managed challenge (HTTP 403 empty-or-'Just a moment...' body, header Cf-Mitigated: challenge, 0.04-0.12s) on EVERY HTML/sitemap path - robots.txt, home, /sitemap.xml, /sitemap_index.xml, /wp-sitemap.xml, /post-sitemap.xml, /news-sitemap.xml, /feed/, /?m=YYYYMMDD, /{YYYY}/{MM}/{DD}/, /lajme/, /en/, and the article pages themselves (+ their /amp/ copies) - on www+apex and http+https, refused from the very first request (04:00Z) and persistently across 100+ tries in 8h; robots.txt is 403 so it is assumed_open, i.e. this is a WAF block not a robots refusal. The ONLY live path is the WordPress REST API (https://ata.gov.al/wp-json/wp/v2/posts returns 200 from origin PHP/8.2.35), which does hold the whole day (X-WP-Total 119 / 52 / 86 for 2026-09-30 / 10-10 / 10-20 via ?after=&before=&per_page=100) but its JSON escapes every slash (https:\/\/...), so no absolute article URL can be extracted from it, and the article URLs it names are challenged anyway - so empty list_templates is the correct outcome until the block is lifted; then the recipe would be that REST call plus the canonical /{YYYY}/{MM}/{DD}/<slug>/ links.
